text:
Jordan: quick sync — follow-up from the postmortem covering missing spans, bad aggregation, and ETL lag. I'd like to consolidate owners and timelines into one remediation board. who can drive?
Alex: I can drive the board and link PRs. want to split into three top-level tasks (spans, aggregator, etl). I'll own coordination.
Priya: I can take the missing spans schema + instrumentation changes. estimate 1 week for patch + rollout to staging.
Matt: I'll take the aggregation correctness (dedupe/windowing). I saw the bad merge key in the reducer. need ~10 days including regression tests. log snippet I saw: 
```
2026-03-22T08:12:34Z aggregator ERROR reconciliation: inconsistent-merge-key id=abcd1234 window=60s
```
Samira: I'll own the ETL lag root-cause and scheduler backpressure fix. There's a recurring pattern when batch jobs overlap with midnight backups. Plan: short-term stagger + long-term backpressure token bucket.
Alex: proposed timeline in the board draft: 
- Missing spans (Priya) target: 2026-03-30
- Aggregation dedupe/window (Matt) target: 2026-04-05
- ETL scheduler/backpressure (Samira) target: 2026-04-07
I'll create cards and assign owners + a CI gating checklist.
Priya: ask — do we want a canary rollout for the spans change or just instrument first? prefer canary 10% -> 50% to avoid noise.
Matt: +1 to canary. Also adding a regression eval for the daily aggregation metric: run historical compare (last 30 days) as part of PR checks. I can add the script.
Samira: for ETL, short-term mitigations I will push today: stagger windows and alert on queue depth > 80%. long-term token-bucket will be an infra change (needs Matt's help for metrics hooks).
oncall-bot: Incident 1849123456 marked RESOLVED by oncall. (automated note)
Jordan: nice. Alex — please add explicit rollback criteria on each card (latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1%). owners: add weekly check-ins until items are closed.
Alex: done — created board and added cards + checklists. sharing link: https://redwood.internal/boards/observability-remediations (internal).
Priya: will open the spans PR today and add telemetry flags for canary. PR title: "spans: schema validation + instrumentation (canary)"
Matt: opening aggregation PR tomorrow morning. adding unit tests and the 30-day regression job.
Samira: pushed staggered schedule to prod (low-risk) and created follow-up card for token-bucket infra work.
Jordan: thanks all. action summary (from this thread) ->
- Alex: owner consolidation + board (in progress)
- Priya: missing spans schema + canary (target 2026-03-30)
- Matt: aggregation dedupe + regression tests (target 2026-04-05)
- Samira: ETL stagger + backpressure plan (short-term done, long-term target 2026-04-07)
We'll do a 15-min check-in Friday to verify progress. If anything slips, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
